tests.description: Fake Hugging Face import path pins hf://Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct@abc123 and resolves a digest-addressed artifact without external network access.
Registers MLModel and MLModelVersion with Hugging Face source, apache-2.0 license, chat_completions task, safetensors format, vLLM runtime, and GPU requirements.
Resolves fake HF artifact hashes, records an OCI mirror, validates matching provenance, and records worker-verified digest evidence.
Placement selects the fake worker advertising vLLM, safetensors, chat_completions, gpu_nvidia_cuda, and 48GB VRAM.
Fake vLLM provisioning succeeds, gateway syncs OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Nostr lifecycle status/result hooks fire, 31986-ready state is observed, and /ml renders the read-model path.

Opt-in integration test streams real configured Hugging Face pinned artifact, OCI mirror/provenance, and Blossom mirror response bodies and computes local SHA-256 byte hashes before production PASS; response digest headers are supplemental consistency evidence only, ETag is not treated as a SHA-256 proof, and the gate also verifies vLLM /v1/models plus ML gateway /v1/models include the expected model id without substituting fakes.

Opt-in relay verification publishes a narrowly tagged NIP-78 verification event with expiration, checks per-relay OK/duplicate acceptance, handles AUTH/CLOSED failures, validates NIP-11 metadata, reads back from each accepted relay through scoped kind/author/#d/#t filters, waits for EOSE as catch-up completion, and validates event ID/signature before trusting the relay event.

known_gaps: D4 verifies the acceptance path with fakes and local Nostr read-model mocks only; it intentionally does not contact real Hugging Face, vLLM, GPU, OCI, Blossom, gateway, or relay services.

Production integration readiness is blocked by missing real configured endpoints/credentials/hardware/relay access, expected model id, and expected SHA-256 byte-hash inputs for the configured artifact/mirror bodies tracked by bahia-wiw9.
The normal integration package path is currently blocked by pre-existing compile errors in test/integration/e2e_ci_registry_test.go tracked by bahia-iz8j; the new production gate compiles standalone.
RKNN recipe work is explicitly out of scope for bahia-66ax.4.4.

implementation_notes: D4 added a no-network Go integration harness and a Playwright /ml read-model smoke test for the HF → artifact provenance → GPU/vLLM placement/deploy → Nostr observation → UI acceptance path.
The implemented D4 tests are non-production harness evidence only and must not be used as live integration or relay-readiness evidence.

bahia-jicv added an opt-in production gate guarded by BAHIA_HF_VLLM_PROD_VERIFY; when disabled it skips with exact prerequisites, and when enabled it fails closed if required production inputs are missing. Artifact/mirror PASS requires streaming the response bytes and matching the local SHA-256 to the operator-supplied expected digest.
